mentions.name: MockHack
mentions.description: A security testing site at mockhack.com where visitors can try to hack it; the builder runs obliterated LLMs (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Obliterated, OrcaCyber-Zero, etc.) in their own sandbox to attempt to hack his own sites in response to constant bot attacks.
mentions.problem: The site is getting hit constantly by bots trying to hack it, so the builder red-teams his own sites using sandboxed hacking LLMs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm getting hit constantly by bots trying to hack my site, so I'm trying to hack my own sites. Pretty much I have a few obliterated LLMs (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Obliterated, OrcaCyber-Zero, etc) which run on their own sandbox to try to hack me.

If anyone wants to try it, you can test it on mockhack.com
